chunks: Say: 'He is God the one the most unique,'
ai.seo_question: What does the first verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas mean?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often recited as equivalent to one-third of the Quran due to its comprehensive articulation of divine unity (Tawhid). It serves as a foundational creedal statement, emphasizing God's absolute singularity and incomparability, which is central to both theological discourse and daily devotional practices among Shia Muslims.
